test_mount_client_is_fixture.evidence: filesystem-charms/charms/test-mount-client/charmcraft.yaml:6-8 gives title 'Test mount client', summary 'Operator to test the mount relation from `filesystem-client`', description 'Test mount client'. Decisive evidence is in the repo's release tooling and docs, not just the charm's own metadata: filesystem-charms/.github/workflows/publish.yaml:33-41 lists the exact set of charms released to Charmhub via a build matrix -- filesystem-client, cephfs-server-proxy, nfs-server-proxy, lustre-server-proxy, lustre-server -- and test-mount-client is absent from it. filesystem-charms/README.md:12-15 enumerates the same four user-facing charms (plus filesystem-client) and likewise omits test-mount-client. Its only other reference in the repo is filesystem-charms/tests/integration/conftest.py:236-251, a pytest fixture requiring a LOCAL_TEST_MOUNT_CLIENT env var pointing at a locally-built charm with no Charmhub-pull fallback -- unlike every other charm's fixture in the same file, which falls back to pulling from Charmhub when no local path is given. Together this is strong evidence it is a test-only fixture, never published. Charmhub itself was not queried (out of scope per AGENTS.md), so this rests on repo-internal evidence only.

config_actions_inline.evidence: No config.yaml or actions.yaml exists anywhere under /inputs/repos (excluding .git): `find /inputs/repos -not -path '*/.git/*' \( -iname config.yaml -o -iname actions.yaml \)` returned zero results. Of the 13 charmcraft.yaml files, config: is declared inline in 8 (cephfs-server-proxy, filesystem-client, lustre-server-proxy, lustre-server, nfs-server-proxy, test-mount-client, slurmctld, slurmd, slurmdbd) and actions: inline in 2 (slurmctld, slurmd). apptainer-operator, sackd, slurmrestd, and sssd-operator declare neither key.

notes: All 13 charmcraft.yaml files parsed cleanly with PyYAML safe_load; every one has a top-level name: key, so no_name_key_or_unparseable is empty.

apptainer-operator/charmcraft.yaml declares name: apptainer, not apptainer-operator; sssd-operator/charmcraft.yaml declares name: sssd, not sssd-operator. The repo directory name and the charm's own name: differ in both cases. This matters for doc_claims.py: word-boundary matching must use the charm's name: value, never the repo directory name.

The path-segment search for a 'test-' or '-test' component (find + regex on full paths under /inputs/repos, excluding .git) matched only filesystem-charms/charms/test-mount-client and its own subpaths (charmcraft.yaml, pyproject.toml, src/charm.py). No other charm directory or docs path anywhere in the tree contains such a segment, so the fixture_suspect heuristic in the spec catches exactly the one charm AGENTS.md names and nothing wider.
